# Sanatan International

> A registered 501(c)(3) public-benefit organisation in El Sobrante, California,
> building a permanent 33-acre Gurukul campus for the Indian diaspora. The
> organisation works across four areas: Gurukul-based education, Ayurveda research
> and preventive health, ethical technology for human welfare, and sustainable
> indigenous production.

Founded 2024. Serving the San Francisco Bay Area — Oakland, San Jose, Fremont,
Santa Clara, Richmond — and the global Indian diaspora. Teaching languages:
English, Hindi, Sanskrit.

## About the organisation

- [Home](https://www.sanataninternational.org/): Sanatan International — a permanent Gurukul campus for the Indian diaspora in California.
- [The Hub](https://www.sanataninternational.org/hub): About, vision, mission, founders and advisors in one place.
- [About the Centre](https://www.sanataninternational.org/about): Our founding story, values, and what makes the Centre different.
- [Vision & Mission](https://www.sanataninternational.org/vision): A permanent campus for human flourishing — the why behind the work.
- [Founders & Advisors](https://www.sanataninternational.org/founders): Meet the team and advisory board guiding the Centre.
- [Impact](https://www.sanataninternational.org/impact): Who we have reached and what has changed — measured outcomes.
- [Campus Vision](https://www.sanataninternational.org/campus): 33-acre campus renders — Gurukul, yoga, Ayurveda gardens and farm.

## Gurukul education

- [Gurukul](https://www.sanataninternational.org/gurukul): Gurukul-based education rooted in Vedic tradition, for every age and stage.
- [Gurukul Foundation](https://www.sanataninternational.org/gurukul/foundation): The foundation programme — the base of the four-level Gurukul curriculum.
- [Gurukul Programs](https://www.sanataninternational.org/gurukul/programs): Kids programmes and the adult ladder — every age, every stage, one path.
- [Digital Gurukul](https://www.sanataninternational.org/gurukul/digital): Live daily classes online — Sanskrit, yoga, Ayurveda and Vedic knowledge.
- [Meta Gurukul](https://www.sanataninternational.org/gurukul/meta-gurukul): The Meta Gurukul app — daily practice, tracking and community.
- [Gurukul Ayurveda](https://www.sanataninternational.org/gurukul/ayurveda): Ayurveda studies within the Gurukul — herbs, doshas and classical texts.
- [Join the Gurukul](https://www.sanataninternational.org/gurukul/join): Enrolment — fees, schedule and how to apply.

## Ayurveda & research

- [Ayurveda Research](https://www.sanataninternational.org/ayurveda): Ayurveda research, herb studies and evidence-based preventive health.
